name: JeffLocal — WhatsApp Intake

nodes.name: WhatsApp Webhook (Meta)
nodes.notes: Meta sends all incoming WhatsApp messages here. URL: https://dashboard.app-avamed.uk/webhook/whatsapp — BUT: in this n8n workflow we handle the reply logic. The Flask webhook route calls this workflow via HTTP.

nodes.name: Respond 200 to Meta
nodes.notes: Always respond 200 immediately. Meta will retry if it gets anything else.

nodes.name: Process via JeffLocal (Flask)
nodes.notes: Flask handles conversation state, Ollama extraction, patient matching.

nodes.name: Send Reply via Meta API
nodes.notes: Send Jeff's reply text back to the patient.

nodes.name: Log Completion
nodes.notes: Handoff JSON was already written by Flask. This just logs it.

notes: JeffLocal WhatsApp Intake Workflow. Import this into n8n at localhost:5678. Requires env vars: WA_API_VERSION, WA_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WA_ACCESS_TOKEN. The Flask app at localhost:5000 handles conversation state and Ollama extraction.
